title: mremoteNG config pointing to wrong directory, from other version
author: goudeseunejJYZ
body_snippet: I run portable versions, download them extract in folder by version. When I import confCons.xml, it always points to older folder, even creating the folders again. When I start from mRemoteNG-nightly-20260324-v1.82.0-beta.3-48c2963-x64, it points to other folder.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Tracked. Needs an investigation pass — the portable→installed switchover has a known edge case where the resolver picks the first-win directory rather than the most-recent one.

Will update here once I have a reproduction. If you have a minimal set of steps (from which version, to which version, portable or installed, OS), please add them and it will speed the fix.

comments.snippet:

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Follow-up commit `5ff870f17` on `main` — addresses the remaining stale-load path that a post-merge Codex review flagged on the first fix.

**What was still wrong:** in commit `d43382e84` the resolver returned the saved `ConnectionFilePath` silently as long as the file still existed, which meant anyone who had once picked a path and now had a newer `confCons.xml` appear in another well-known location would keep loading the old one. Exactly the behaviour you reported.

comments.author: robertpopa22
comments.snippet:
Shipped on `main` (commits `d43382e84`, `5ff870f17`, `70edf940b`). Closing as resolved.

**What's in the fix:**
- Multi-candidate connection-file picker at startup (scans portable, `AppData\Local\mRemoteNG`, and `AppData\Local\mRemoteNG Connection Manager`)
- "Remember this choice" persists via a path-set fingerprint (autosave mtime churn no longer invalidates it)
- Cancel in the picker uses the default startup path instead of silently falling back to the old saved path
- Reset button in Options...
